question_answered: How do the original notification (DOC-OFF-002) and the supplementary notification (DOC-OFF-003) reconcile, and which is the controlling reading?
only_valid_source: The official TGPRB / TSLPRB notifications for this recruitment (DOC-OFF-002 and DOC-OFF-003)
status_meaning: All five reconciliation records are VERIFIED from the two retrieved notifications. The supplementary notification is an age-only amendment; it does not contradict the base notification.
reading_basis: WHITESPACE_NORMALISED_VERBATIM from the committed page-marked extraction artefacts for DOC-OFF-002 (page 16) and DOC-OFF-003 (page 1); each quote re-checked for whitespace-normalised containment. Both cited documents are RETRIEVED.
base_document: DOC-OFF-002 — Rc No. 225 / Rect. / Rect-1 / 2026 dated 29-07-2026
reconciliation_summary: The supplementary notification amends nothing but the upper age limit for the posts named in four notifications issued on 29-07-2026. For this SI recruitment it amends Para No. 15-B (i). The amendment is purely additive: GO Ms No. 122 (14-08-2026) adds a further 2 years in addition to the 5 years already raised by GO Ms No. 87 (18-05-2026). The two documents therefore do not conflict. The controlling reading combines the base 25-year upper limit from DOC-OFF-002 with both raises, giving an effective general upper limit of 32 years as on 1 July 2026; the minimum age of 21 years is unchanged. Every other aspect of the recruitment (vacancies and post codes, marks structure, syllabus, exam pattern, phases, dates, physical standards) is governed by DOC-OFF-002 alone. Referenced by OFF-F09 'current_official_resolution'.
rules: A supplementary notification may amend the base notification; where the two touch the same subject, the amended reading controls.
An additive amendment (a relaxation added to an existing reading) is not a conflict. Only a contradiction would require one document to be set aside.
The effective reading after an additive amendment is arithmetic over the sourced components and must be labelled as derived, never as a freshly stated official figure.
Do not silently merge this reading into historical_observed.json or estimated_priority.json; the derived upper-age reading stays here under T1_OFFICIAL.

age.basis: base 25 (DOC-OFF-002) + 5 (GO Ms No. 87, as recorded in DOC-OFF-002) + 2 (GO Ms No. 122, as recorded in DOC-OFF-003). Derived by deterministic arithmetic; see record REC-005.
age.relaxations: Category relaxations (TS govt employees, ex-servicemen, NCC instructor, SC/ST/BC/EWS) in DOC-OFF-002 apply in addition to the raised general upper limit.

current_reading.everything_else: Governed by DOC-OFF-002; DOC-OFF-003 makes no change.
